_comment: Sizing hints for the research screen (screens/map_related_screens/research.py) only -- this file does not map unit names to art files, and neither the map nor any other screen reads these sizing hints.
_comment_button_scale: 'button_scale' (default 1.0) multiplies the size of the research screen's tech node buttons themselves while this style is active. Useful if a style's art still looks cramped/oversized after per-icon scaling below. Example: 1.2 for 20% bigger buttons.
_comment_icon_scales: 'icon_scales' maps a discovered or manifest filename (including its culture subfolder, e.g. 'french/Char_B1_bis.png') to a multiplier (default 1.0) the research screen applies on top of its own zoom for that specific image. Exists because this style's source art is a much higher native resolution than classic's hand-sized icons and would otherwise blow well past the button that contains it. Filenames not listed here (e.g. the infantry sprites, already close to classic's scale) are left at 1.0.
_comment_button_scale_overrides: 'button_scale_overrides' maps a manifest name key to {'width': ..., 'height': ...} (either omittable, default 1.0 each), multiplied on top of 'button_scale' for that tech's node button specifically. Matched first against the exact key (e.g. 'Artillery I'), then against the bare family name with any trailing Roman numeral stripped ('Artillery') -- so one 'Artillery' entry below widens the button for all three artillery tiers at once instead of needing an entry per tier.
